## Executive summary

This case study predicts whether a residential property was built before 1980 from structural, condition, quality, garage, architectural, and transaction attributes. The model deliberately excludes `yrbuilt`, the field used to construct the target, as well as the target itself and the parcel identifier.

On a deterministic, stratified 20% holdout set, the selected random-forest model reaches approximately 92.4% accuracy, 92.1% balanced accuracy, 0.938 F1, and 0.977 ROC-AUC. The result exceeds the original 90% accuracy objective without directly exposing the build year.

## Data and feature boundary

The analysis downloads the 22,913-row `dwellings_ml.csv` table from the BYU Data Science `data4dwellings` repository. See `DATASET.md` for provenance and redistribution notes.

```{python}
from src.property_age_model import load_dataset, prepare_features

data = load_dataset()
X, y = prepare_features(data)
print(data.shape)
print(sorted(set(data.columns) - set(X.columns)))
```

The three excluded columns are:

- `before1980`: the prediction target;
- `yrbuilt`: direct target leakage;
- `parcel`: a high-cardinality identifier with no portable explanatory value.

## Modeling choice

A class-balanced random forest provides strong nonlinear performance, works directly with the already encoded numeric table, and exposes impurity-based feature importance for a transparent first-pass explanation. The pipeline uses a fixed seed, stratification, 400 trees, `sqrt` feature sampling, and a minimum leaf size of two.

```{python}
from src.property_age_model import run_analysis

result = run_analysis(data, output_dir="reports/figures")
result["metrics"]
```

## Evaluation

The holdout confusion matrix is reported alongside accuracy, balanced accuracy, F1, and ROC-AUC. Balanced accuracy is included because 62.5% of the records are pre-1980; it gives equal weight to performance on both classes. ROC-AUC evaluates ranking quality across decision thresholds, while F1 summarizes the precision/recall tradeoff for the pre-1980 class.

![Holdout confusion matrix](../reports/figures/confusion-matrix.png)

## Explainability

Architectural style, living area, story count, bathroom count, attached-garage status, and transaction-value fields are among the strongest signals. These importances describe the fitted model, not causal relationships: they should guide inspection rather than claims about why a home is old.

![Top model features](../reports/figures/feature-importance.png)

## Limitations

- The data represents one assessment context and may not generalize to other cities or time periods.
- Some transaction-value fields can drift with market conditions.
- Feature importance can be biased toward variables with many possible split points.
- An external validation set would be required before operational use.
- The source repository does not declare a dataset license, so this portfolio downloads the data at runtime instead of redistributing it.

## Reproduce

```powershell
python -m pip install -r requirements.txt
python -m unittest discover -s tests -v
python -m src.property_age_model --output reports/figures
```
